units.rawText: Professor! I'm here! I heard you need me. I'm guessing you need me to search for something again? I'm totes okay with any kind of mission, so bring it on!

units.rawText: There's nothing of the sort today, Abigail. Just want you to recount the story of when we first met.

units.rawText: Umm... okay, then. When I woke up, I saw nobody but Abby, and I wasn't in the Neural Cloud Sector already; there were only Null Areas around us.

units.rawText: Since Abby and I had been trained to survive in any sorta harsh situation, we thought there'd be no problem... But that day, when the Sanctifiers suddenly appeared, I'd been wholly proven wrong.

units.rawText: Abby and I were being chased non-stop, and just as I thought we were done for, Abby picked up on a familiar presence nearby. With no other options, we ran toward it as our last resort.

units.rawText: Hohoho, and then you ran into the field team I was leading, right? Abigail, you truly are remarkable; you even helped us locate other Dolls right after joining our team!

units.rawText: Eh-hehe~ After all, Abby and I are the best when it comes to searching! Scouting, scouring, skirmishing... you can count on us for anything!
